title: NormalizedAiAnalysis
description: Schema for a normalized AI analysis response (after mapping from raw MCP output)

summary.description: One-paragraph executive summary of the analysis

keyFindings.description: Bullet-point key findings from the analysis

topRisks.description: Top risk items ordered by severity

recommendedActions.description: Concrete recommended actions to address the findings

missingCoverageAreas.description: Specific coverage gaps identified (coverage analysis only)

confidence.description: Model confidence level in the analysis

isFallback.description: True when the result was generated by the local fallback interpreter
